fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk Corp. (NASDAQ:SNDK) closed Wednesday up 13.69% at $977.69, with Evercore ISI reaffirming an Outperform rating at a $2,500 price target (156% upside).
fields.summary_ko.1: Fiscal 2027 Q1 net income surged 7,133% year-over-year to $8.1 billion, and revenue increased 378% to $11.03 billion, reflecting strong demand for NAND products.
fields.summary_ko.2: Enhanced supply discipline, AI demand, and high-bandwidth flash are expected to support more sustainable profitability, with NAND price increases extending from a historical 2 quarters to 6 quarters.
